jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Keeper Security is hiring a Product Marketing Manager to drive business growth and market the company's products to support its rapid expansion. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help shape the product's go-to-market strategy, create compelling messaging and positioning, launch new features and enable the revenue team.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will play a critical role in positioning Keeper Security’s products within the competitive cybersecurity landscape. If you're passionate about technology, love crafting compelling stories and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

- Lead and execute cross-functional product and feature launches, partnering with product, sales, demand generation and customer success

- Define use cases, product messaging and positioning, value propositions and customer profiles that resonate with target audiences, including Commercial, Public Sector (FED/SLED) and MSP

- Become a subject matter expert in privileged access management and password management with an in-depth understanding of the market and products, including overall value proposition, features, functionality and the verticals and use cases in which they are relevant

- Partner with product management and demand generation teams to craft content around new products and features that drive product awareness and lead generation

- Coordinate webinars with demand generation and product teams, from topic and speaker development through promotion and follow-up content, to drive engagement and pipeline

- Work closely with the SEO team to produce SEO-optimized blogs, web pages and videos around product features, use cases and more

- Collaborate with channel partners to develop co-marketing initiatives and campaigns

- Act as the voice of the customer, collaborating with customer success to gather feedback and develop case studies, testimonials and user stories, as well as to inform product development and marketing strategies

- Conduct market research and competitor analysis to influence product marketing strategies, identifying opportunities for differentiation and growth

Requirements

- 5+ years of B2B cybersecurity, SaaS-focused experience in a product/solutions marketing role

- Experience with differentiated product messaging, positioning and market leadership supporting go-to-market, external and internal messaging and communications

- Comfortable using AI tools to boost productivity and creativity, but exercises strong judgment in validating output, refining messaging and ensuring quality across all deliverables

- Experience with successful cross-functional product and feature launches

- Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills, as well as strong messaging skills

- Project management skills to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment

- Self-starter and a problem solver who works well within a team (both local and distributed)

- Someone who is innovative, fast-paced, energetic and a great team cross-functional collaborator

- Results-driven, analytical yet pragmatic, with a bias for action

- Strategic thinking to understand markets and competitors combined with tactical planning and execution discipline

Benefits

- Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)

- Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life

- Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

- 401K (Roth/Traditional)

- A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

- Above market annual bonuses

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Role

This role will define and drive the vision, strategy and roadmap for Keeper’s consumer product line across web, mobile, desktop and browser extension platforms. The ideal candidate has strong experience building and growing consumer software products, with a deep understanding of user behavior, product-led growth and cross-platform product execution. This role will partner closely with engineering, design and marketing to deliver a cohesive, secure and intuitive experience across every customer touchpoint, while driving adoption, engagement, conversion and long-term customer value.

Responsibilities

- Own the vision, strategy and multi-release roadmap for Keeper’s consumer product line across web, iOS, Android, desktop and browser extensions

- Deliver a consistent, cohesive and intuitive cross-platform experience, ensuring feature parity and a unified customer journey wherever users access Keeper

- Partner closely with marketing to shape positioning, messaging, pricing and packaging, promotions and go-to-market plans for new features and releases

- Drive consumer growth by optimizing acquisition, activation, onboarding, conversion from free to paid, retention and expansion into add-on products

- Manage the full product lifecycle from discovery and planning through development, launch and iteration

- Prioritize and manage the product backlog based on customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, working closely with engineering and design

- Champion the individual and family customer by conducting user research, analyzing behavior and translating insights into prioritized product opportunities

- Define, track and analyze key product and growth metrics, including activation, retention, conversion, engagement and lifetime value, to inform roadmap and investment decisions

- Grow adoption and engagement of consumer add-on products such as BreachWatch, secure file storage and secure messaging

- Coordinate across engineering, design, marketing, support and documentation teams to ensure successful launches and strong customer adoption

- Monitor consumer security trends, competitive dynamics and platform changes across app stores, browsers and operating systems that impact the product

- Advocate for a security-first, privacy-by-design and frictionless user experience across consumer product decisions

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in product management, with a strong track record in consumer (B2C) software products

- Demonstrated success delivering consumer products across multiple platforms, including web, mobile and desktop, with measurable user and business outcomes

- Experience driving consumer growth metrics such as acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and engagement

- Proven ability to partner with marketing on positioning, pricing and packaging and go-to-market strategy for consumer products

- Strong customer empathy and experience using qualitative and quantitative research to inform product decisions

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, design, marketing and business stakeholders

- Comfort working with data and analytics tools to define metrics, run experiments and measure impact

- Highly organized with strong execution skills and attention to detail

- Experience working in Agile software development environments

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; degree in business, design or a related field preferred

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with subscription, freemium or free-to-paid consumer business models

- Familiarity with cybersecurity, privacy, password management or identity-related products

- Experience shipping and optimizing mobile apps and browser extensions, including app store and web store best practices

- Hands-on experience with A/B testing, growth experimentation and product analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar tools

- Understanding of consumer onboarding, lifecycle marketing and retention strategies

- Passion for making complex security and privacy tools simple and accessible for everyday users and families

Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Privileged Access Management (PAM)

Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Technical Product Manager to help shape the strategy, roadmap and growth of Keeper’s Privileged Access Management platform. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL or El Dorado Hills, CA metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help define the future of privileged access across secrets management, secure remote access, endpoint privilege management, discovery, machine identity and related security capabilities.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Job

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for KeeperPAM, you will help shape product strategy and roadmap direction across the broader Privileged Access Management portfolio rather than owning a single product area. You will work across capabilities including secrets management, secure remote access, endpoint privilege management, discovery, machine identity and related infrastructure security workflows. The role requires someone who can connect customer needs, market trends and technical opportunities across the PAM ecosystem and help determine where Keeper should invest next. You will partner closely with Engineering, Security, Solutions, Sales and customers to define product priorities, evaluate new opportunities and translate complex technical requirements into clear product direction. This is a highly technical product role for someone who understands the broader PAM market and can move comfortably across multiple products, technologies and use cases.

Responsibilities

- Shape product strategy and roadmap priorities across the broader KeeperPAM portfolio

- Identify and evaluate opportunities that span multiple PAM capabilities, including secrets management, secure remote access, endpoint privilege management, discovery and machine identity

- Develop a deep understanding of privileged access workflows across IT, Security, DevOps, infrastructure and enterprise customers

- Evaluate customer needs, market trends, competitive developments and emerging technologies across the PAM ecosystem

- Define and prioritize cross-product requirements and initiatives that strengthen KeeperPAM as a cohesive platform

- Translate complex customer and technical needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and product priorities

- Partner closely with Engineering on APIs, SDKs, command-line tools, authentication flows, connection protocols, integrations and platform architecture

- Work directly with customers, Solutions Engineering, Sales and Support to understand pain points, validate product direction and identify new opportunities

- Shape developer and administrator experiences across configuration, automation, integrations, access workflows and self-service capabilities

- Evaluate competitors and adjacent markets across PAM, secrets management, machine identity, secure remote access and zero-trust infrastructure access

- Define and track product success metrics, including adoption, usage, customer impact, retention and revenue contribution

- Partner with Technical Program Management and Engineering teams to ensure strategic priorities are clearly understood and translated into executable initiatives

- Coordinate with Marketing, Sales, Solutions and Documentation to support successful launches and go-to-market execution

- Use AI-enabled tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms to improve product research, technical analysis, requirements development, competitive intelligence and documentation

Requirements

- 5+ years of product management experience with technical, infrastructure-focused or cybersecurity products

- Direct experience with Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity & Access Management (IAM), Secure Remote Access, DevOps security or a closely related cybersecurity market"

- Strong understanding of privileged access concepts including least privilege, credential management, Privilege and secrets lifecycle, privileged sessions, policy enforcement and just-in-time access

- Strong technical fluency with APIs, SDKs, command-line tools, authentication and authorization patterns, and enterprise integrations

- Familiarity with secrets management workflows including storage, access, rotation, injection, auditing and revocation

- Familiarity with secure remote access and privileged session concepts, including SSH, RDP or related enterprise connectivity technologies

- Understanding of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes and modern DevOps environments

- Ability to read technical documentation, understand implementation details and work effectively with engineers on architecture, requirements and technical tradeoffs

- Experience defining and delivering complex, integration-heavy or developer-focused product capabilities

- Strong customer discovery, market analysis and product prioritization skills

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for engineering, customer and executive audiences

- Experience in Agile environments with demonstrated ability to define leading/lagging KPIs and use metrics to drive prioritization and execution

- Ability and willingness to use AI-enabled tools effectively for research, technical analysis, prioritization, documentation and workflow efficiency

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Product management experience with a commercial PAM, secrets management, secure remote access or identity security platform

- Familiarity with products such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, HashiCorp Vault, Teleport, StrongDM, Akeyless or similar technologies

- Experience with machine identity, workload identity or non-human identity security

- Experience with endpoint privilege management or privileged account discovery

- Experience supporting developer and DevOps workflows involving Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Kubernetes or similar platforms

- Experience with privileged session management, credential-free access or remote access gateways

- Hands-on experience writing code, scripts or technical prototypes

- Experience with cloud-native and multi-cloud environments

- Familiarity with zero-trust and just-in-time access architectures

- Experience launching and growing enterprise cybersecurity or developer platform products

Benefits

- Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)

- Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental Life

- Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

- 401K (Roth/Traditional)

- A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc.)

- Above-market annual bonuses

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

- You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)

- You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

- Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements

- Object to or restrict processing

- Withdraw consent (where applicable)

- Request data portability

- Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com
